description: This Dart source file defines a mock repository class for quizzes, providing static in-memory sample data for various quiz topics such as history, science, math, programming, and more. It includes data models for quiz questions and catalogs, with detailed question text, options, correct answers, and explanations.

classes.name: MockQuizzesData
classes.description: Provides static, in-memory quiz data for testing and development purposes.

methods.name: find
methods.description: Helper method to locate a quiz catalog by its ID within the mock data.
